entries: A Whisper in the Dark In the darkness, Azros wrought many things. He fueled them with unnatural life, and his dark temperament. At first, these methods did not always work in his favor, for his rebellious nature became directed at him,
暗夜低语 黑暗之中，阿兹罗斯造物无数。他以非自然之生命与阴郁之性情为其注入力量。起初，这些手段并非总能如他所愿——他生性叛逆，而这叛逆最终反噬其身，

and many of his first creations fled into the dark. In time he refined his work, and subservience became the norm.

	One of his early works, if one may call them that, still lives below this place. Though we call these halls home, something else called them home first. I know what you think, that I speak of Neladra; that wretched thing of legend.

他最初的许多造物因此逃入黑暗。随着时间推移，他不断完善技艺，驯顺与服从遂成常态。

	他早期的一件作品——如果还能称之为作品——如今仍活在这片地方的下方。我们虽以这些厅堂为家，却另有他物比我们更早以此为家。我知道你在想什么：你在想我说的是内拉德拉，传说中的那不祥之物。

No, she has not been seen for centuries. I speak of Izurak, one of the first creations of Azros, and the first to rebel against him. Do not be mistaken, that rebellion against the dark lord is a sign of good. I do not know what its motives are, though perhaps they are good. Or maybe it seeks to help the enemy of its enemy... but I received a boon from this creature.
不，她已数百年未现踪影。我说的是伊祖拉克——阿兹罗斯最初的造物之一，亦是第一个反叛他的造物。别误会，反抗黑暗领主，常被视为善举的迹象。我不知它的动机为何，或许它心怀善意；又或许它只想帮助敌人的敌人……但我的确从这生物手中受过一份恩惠。

What boon, and how you ask? I dare not share this secret, for fear of your safety if something were to go wrong. But if persistent you yet remain, then seek the name it gave itself, for Izurak was the name given by Azros. You have only to call, and if it is near... you shall see.

	Andimus, son of Halle

你问是什么恩惠、如何得到？我不敢吐露这个秘密，唯恐万一出错会危及你的安全。但若你执意追寻，就去寻它为自己取的名字吧——伊祖拉克是阿兹罗斯给它的名字。你只需呼唤，若它就在附近……你自会见到。

	安迪穆斯，哈勒之子
